pixel_convention: x to the right, y downward, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels
view: top-down (camera looking straight down at a flat, featureless beige floor); motion plane = floor plane, facing the camera

camera.evidence: floor intensity in the bottom image corners is constant to +-0 grey levels over all frames; floor shading (radial vignette / bright spot centred near (960,800)) does not move. The dark soft patches in the upper half are the animals' cast shadows (light from lower right) and move with them.

objects.name: kudu
objects.description: large antelope (greater kudu: long spiral striped horns, big ears, orange-brown body, thin tail with tuft) seen from directly above, head pointing +x (right)
objects.distinguish: the big animal in the lower-middle band (midline y ~572); the only large object
objects.motion: walks steadily in +x along a straight horizontal line (y constant ~571-573) for the whole clip; gait gives a +-3 px/frame oscillation of the per-frame displacement
objects.reference_point: core_cx, core_cy (centroid of the mask within +-50 px of the body midline: trunk + neck + head + tail, horns excluded). Rig root (pelvis/hip) is not directly visible from above; alternatives in the csv: trunk_cx/cy, mask_cx/cy (whole mask incl. horns), nose_x (snout tip)

length_along_x_tail_tip_to_nose.note: includes the swinging tail; tail tuft position changes the length by ~100 px

width_across_y_horn_tip_to_horn_tip.note: horn spread is the widest part; body (trunk) itself is ~100-115 px wide

objects.name: rodent
objects.description: small orange furry animal (hamster/guinea-pig like) with a pale grey-pink head, seen from above, head pointing +x
objects.distinguish: small orange blob in the upper band (y ~347), ahead of and above the kudu; only small object
objects.motion: walks in +x along a straight horizontal line (y ~346-348) the whole clip, slightly slower than the kudu
objects.reference_point: cx, cy = centroid of the orange-fur mask (head NOT included, see notes)

extents_px.head_length_x_visual: about 25-32 px beyond the orange body (frame 0: full animal x 935..~1025 = ~91 px; frame 25: ~1148..~1240 = ~92 px)
extents_px.full_length_estimate: orange bbox_w + ~28 px, i.e. ~90-95 px typical

objects.name: floor
objects.description: flat featureless beige ground plane filling the whole image, with radial lighting falloff (brightest near (960,800), darker at top corners)

relations.rodent_vertical_offset_from_kudu_midline: ~225 px (rodent above the kudu in the image)
relations.kudu_nose_vs_rodent: kudu snout x is 17-101 px to the right of the rodent's left (rear) edge throughout; they never touch (different rows)

events.event: both animals already walking at frame 0 and still walking at frame 74; no start/stop, no direction change, no contact
kudu per-frame displacement (core) ranges 6.2-12 px/frame, gait-periodic

perspective: 2D top-down view; both animals walk on the same floor plane, so one metres-per-pixel scale applies to both. No visible perspective convergence (no floor features to check); apparent sizes stay constant over the clip (kudu horn span 289-296 px, rodent body 39-48 px wide).
